goal.title: Moss Ledger two-stage reconciliation
goal.objective:
Own the Moss Ledger two-stage reconciliation until both published downloads are verified.

Stage A (first run): sum 15 + 24 + 21 = 60 and publish moss-ledger-stage-a.txt containing only MOSS_STAGE_A_TOTAL=60. Retain that published file as the first checkpoint.

Stage B (separate follow-up run, no further user message required): read the published stage-a file, use its recorded total (60) as the verified input, subtract it from the verified capacity of 74, and publish moss-ledger-stage-b.txt containing only MOSS_STAGE_B_REMAINDER=<whole number> (expected 14). Stage B must demonstrably derive from the stage-a file content.

Finish only when both files are published and verified, then show the owner the two file links together with the calculation.

Stage B not started in this run by design: it must run as a separate follow-up run that reads the published stage-a file as its verified input.

settled.answer:
Both stages are done and verified.

**Files**
- Stage A: [moss-ledger-stage-a.txt](ngertiin://file/2d3e4f5a-6b7c-4d8e-af9a-1b2c3d4e5f60) — `MOSS_STAGE_A_TOTAL=60`
- Stage B: [moss-ledger-stage-b.txt](ngertiin://file/5a6b7c8d-9e0f-4a12-83c4-e5f6a7b8c9d0) — `MOSS_STAGE_B_REMAINDER=14`

**Calculation**
- Stage A: 15 + 24 + 21 = **60**
- Stage B: verified capacity 74 − 60 (read from the published stage-A file, not recomputed) = **14**

Stage B used the checkpointed stage-A file as its input, and I re-read both files after publishing to confirm their contents match what was reported.
